Add a Custom Map Legend (add_legend)

Source: R/controls.R
add_legend.Rd

Supports both glmap native arguments (title, colors, labels, domain, position) and leaflet::addLegend(map, position = "bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~val, title = ...) positional and formula arguments.

Usage

add_legend(
  map,
  title = "Legend",
  colors = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  domain = NULL,
  position = "bottom-right",
  direction = "vertical",
  order = 20,
  layer_id = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  pal = NULL,
  values = NULL,
  opacity = 1,
  layerId = NULL,
  labFormat = NULL,
  data = NULL
)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

title

Legend title (or position string when called positionally like addLegend(map, "bottomright", ...)).

colors

Character vector of hex/CSS colors (or a palette function when pal is used).

labels

Character vector of category labels (for categorical legends).

domain

Numeric vector c(min, max) (for continuous legends).

position

One of the 9 anchor positions (default "bottom-right").

direction

Layout direction ("vertical" or "horizontal").

order

Numeric draw order within the anchor zone (default 20).

layer_id

Optional associated layer ID.

group

Optional associated layer group name (legend hides automatically when group is hidden).

pal

Optional color_numeric / leaflet::colorNumeric palette function for drop-in leaflet::addLegend() compatibility.

values

Optional numeric/categorical values vector or formula (~val) when using pal.

opacity

Optional numeric opacity.

layerId

Optional alias for layer_id (leaflet compatibility).

labFormat

Optional label format function (leaflet compatibility).

data

Optional dataset used to evaluate values = ~col formulas (defaults to map data).
